title: Boy Scout and Sister, Shingle Cabin Wall - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of two smiling young siblings standing beside a cedar shingle-sided building with a cinder block foundation. The boy on the left wears a classic early 20th-century Boy Scouts of America uniform complete with a broad-brimmed campaign hat, dark neckerchief, button-up shirt, knickerbockers tucked into knee-high socks, and laced boots. The girl wears a light-colored dress with a wide white collar, a dark contrasting bow or necktie, bobby socks, low-heeled shoes, and a headband. The scene evokes rural or camp life in early 1930s America during the golden age of youth scouting organizations.
